_doc: One adventure-map mechanic per playable faction (src/game/faction_mechanics.gd). Keyed by faction id; every faction with a town type must have exactly one. `mechanic` picks the rule, the other keys are its parameters. Player-wide mechanics follow the player's faction (militia_levy, plunder, whisper_web); hero mechanics follow the hero's own faction (wildwalk, tidebound, grave_harvest, feast_of_victory, deep_roads). ai: StrategicAI hints. militia_levy {per_mine, max_per_town}: at the start of each week every town of the player gains per_mine tier-1 recruits per mine the player holds (at most max_per_town). plunder {mine_days, town_days}: capturing a mine pays mine_days of its output at once; taking a town from another player pays town_days of its daily income. grave_harvest {pct, creature}: after a won battle, pct of the hit points of the living enemies slain rise as `creature` in the hero's army. wildwalk {mods}: HeroModifiers mods for the faction's heroes (terrain costs). tidebound {pct}: a hero that starts the day on swamp or a river ford, or next to water or a ford, moves pct farther that day. feast_of_victory {pct}: the first won battle of a day gives back pct of the hero's daily movement. deep_roads {min_movement_pct}: a hero on or next to one of the player's mines, or in one of its towns, can travel to any other of the player's mines or towns; it needs min_movement_pct of its daily movement left and spends all of it. whisper_web {mine_radius, hero_radius}: every day the player sees mine_radius around each of its mines and map sites; at the start of each week it also sees hero_radius around every enemy hero.

concord.name: Levy of the Shires
concord.text: Every mine you hold sends its sons to the colours: each week, every town you own musters 2 extra tier-1 recruits per mine you hold (at most 12 a town).

ashen.name: Brand and Plunder
ashen.text: The Host strips what it takes. Capturing a mine pays four days of its output at once; taking a town from a rival pays three days of its income.

hollow.name: Grave Harvest
hollow.text: No corpse is wasted. After a victory, a tenth of the living foes your hero slew rise as Shamblers and join the army.

thornwood.name: Wildwalk
thornwood.text: The deep wood opens for its own. Thornwood heroes cross forest almost as easily as open ground, and swamp at half the usual toil.

forge.name: Deep Roads
forge.text: The deep folk dig between their holdings. A Forgeborn hero on or next to one of your mines, or in one of your towns, can travel underground to any other mine or town you hold. It needs half a day's movement and spends all that is left.

frostmarch.name: Feast of Victory
frostmarch.text: A won fight fires the blood. The first victory of each day gives a Frostmarch hero back a third of a day's movement.

darkelf.name: Whisper Web
darkelf.text: Spies follow every road. Each of your mines and map sites watches 5 tiles around it, and at the start of each week your informants reveal the land around every enemy hero.

fishmen.name: Tidebound
fishmen.text: The Shoal rides the water. An Abyssal hero that starts the day on swamp or a river ford, or next to deep water or a ford, moves a quarter farther that day.
